objective: Improve regression feedback time while keeping test coverage and making test ownership easier to maintain.

workItems.title: Inventory test cost and shared state
workItems.outcome: Current test files are classified by runtime cost, isolation, and resource ownership.
completionCriteria: Slow files and shared resources have named evidence.
Candidate four-way pool contains only isolated tests.

workItems.title: Create maintainable suite boundaries
workItems.outcome: Tests are grouped by execution isolation without changing assertions or dropping coverage.
completionCriteria: Unit and shared-state suite entry points exist.

workItems.title: Enable safe four-way concurrency
workItems.outcome: Isolated unit tests run with four-way concurrency while unsafe tests stay controlled.
completionCriteria: Four-way command is explicit and reproducible.
Repeated runs show no concurrency flake in migrated tests.

workItems.title: Verify regression speed and stability
workItems.outcome: Regression runtime and stability are compared with serial baseline.

convergenceGate.verification: Full regression and repeated concurrency runs pass with recorded runtime comparison.
convergenceGate.joinCondition: All work items complete without coverage loss or concurrency flake.
